related.title: ABB IRB 6 電動機器人
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付角度定義圖、兩姿態座標及障礙避讓判斷。；接受末端誤差小於 2 mm 且兩條連桿全程不穿越障礙的紙上路徑。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver angle conventions, coordinates for two poses and obstacle-clearance reasoning.; Accept a paper trajectory only if tip error is below 2 mm and neither link crosses the obstacle.
related.difference: 沿減速機追蹤重力負載與馬達扭矩，不混淆輸入端與輸出端。
related.differenceEn: Trace gravity load and motor torque through a gearbox without confusing input and output.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: x=L1 cosθ1+L2 cos(θ1+θ2), y=L1 sinθ1+L2 sin(θ1+θ2).; Teaching links are L1=0.30 m and L2=0.20 m, with θ1=30° and θ2=60°.; x=0.30 cos30°+0.20 cos90°=0.259808 m; y=0.15+0.20=0.35 m.
Static joint torque is τj=mgr and motor demand is τm=τj/(Nη).; Teaching values are 2 kg, 0.25 m, N=50, η=0.80 and g=9.81 m/s².; τj=2×9.81×0.25=4.905 N·m; τm=4.905/(50×0.8)=0.122625 N·m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Boston Dynamics Spot 巡檢平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付角度定義圖、兩姿態座標及障礙避讓判斷。；接受末端誤差小於 2 mm 且兩條連桿全程不穿越障礙的紙上路徑。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver angle conventions, coordinates for two poses and obstacle-clearance reasoning.; Accept a paper trajectory only if tip error is below 2 mm and neither link crosses the obstacle.
related.difference: 建立巡檢路線能量預算，保留回程與資料重測餘裕。
related.differenceEn: Build an inspection-route energy budget including return and remeasurement reserve.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 定功率近似下 t=E可用/P，能量以 Wh、功率以 W 換算小時。；教學電量 100 Wh，保留 20 Wh，平均功率 120 W；任務需 35 min。；t=(100−20)/120×60=40 min；任務剩 5 min 餘裕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: x=L1 cosθ1+L2 cos(θ1+θ2), y=L1 sinθ1+L2 sin(θ1+θ2).; Teaching links are L1=0.30 m and L2=0.20 m, with θ1=30° and θ2=60°.; x=0.30 cos30°+0.20 cos90°=0.259808 m; y=0.15+0.20=0.35 m.

Under constant power, t=usable energy/power; Wh divided by W gives hours.; Teaching energy is 100 Wh with 20 Wh reserved, average power 120 W and mission time 35 min.; t=(100−20)/120×60=40 min, leaving 5 min of mission margin.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
